Government of India
Directorate General of Health Services
Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation
FDA Bhawan, Kotla Road, New Delhi
(New Drugs Division)

FDA Bhawan, Kotla Road,

New Delhi,

Date: |
To
All State/UT Drugs Controllers,
Sub: Prescribing Information Leaflet change for “Mefenamic acid” marketed in
the country- Reg.
Sir,
The National Co-ordination Centre for Pharmacovigilance Programme of India (NCC-
PvPI), functioning at IPC, Ghaziabad has forwarded their recommendation based on
ADR reports on Mefenamic acid which was discussed by them in the 19"" Signal
Review Panel (SRP) under the programme meeting held on 25" Oct, 2021 with an
objective to detect Signal/Prescribing Information Leaflet change from Indian
database and promote patient safety.
In the meeting, PvPI has evaluated the reported ADRs for Mefenamic acid on the
basis of Individual Case Study Reports (ICSRs) and recommended CDSCO to take
necessary steps to incorporate Fixed Drug Eruption (FDE) as an adverse drug
reaction in the Prescribing Information Leaflet (PIL) of Mefenamic acid marketed in
the country.
Subsequently, PvPl recommendations was deliberated in the Subject Expert
Committee (SEC-Analgesic & Rheumatology) meeting held on 19.05.2022 at
CDSCO (HQ), New Delhi.

After detailed deliberation, the committee recommended that CDSCO should
request the State Drugs Controllers to direct the manufacturers of the drug to include
Mefenamic acid induced Fixed Drug Eruption as an adverse drug reaction in the
package insert of the drug as suggested by PvPI.
The recommendation of the SEC has been considered by this office.
Accordingly, you are requested to direct the manufacturers of Mefenamic acid under
your jurisdiction to incorporate Mefenamic acid induced Fixed Drug Eruption
(FDE) as an adverse drug reaction in the package insert/promotional literature of the
drug.
Action taken in this regard may be intimated to this office. |
Yours faithfully,
ur
eet
Dr. V.G. Somani
Drugs Controller General (India)

All Zonal / Sub Zonal offices of CDSCO.
